name: @event-planner/shared
//exports: Points at TypeScript SOURCE, not a build output. Both consumers already transpile TypeScript — the API runs under tsx, the web app under Vite — so a build step here would buy nothing and add a stale-artifact failure mode (edit a schema, forget to rebuild, debug a validation rule that is not the one on disk). The ceiling: if the API ever gains a real compiled production build, this package needs tsc output and this field has to change.
